text: ねむり　どく　やけど　まひ…　ポケモンの　たいちょうが　わるいと　つかまえ　やすいよ　でも…　かならず　とれる　わけじゃ　ないみたい

structure.jp: ねむり　どく　やけど　まひ…
ポケモンの　たいちょうが　わるいと
structure.en: when a Pokémon's condition is bad

structure.jp: つかまえ　やすいよ
でも…　かならず　とれる　わけじゃ　ないみたい
structure.en: but... it seems it's not that you always get it

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい on a verb stem means the action is easy to do. つかまえやすい = 'easy to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜わけではない
patterns.span: とれる　わけじゃ　ない
patterns.explanation: わけじゃない says 'it doesn't mean that', softening a claim; with かならず it gives 'not always'. かならずとれるわけじゃない = 'it's not that you can always catch it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain word says that whenever this is so, the next thing follows. たいちょうがわるいと = 'when its condition is bad'.
